headline: A 2003 executive order changed how many members can serve on the President's Intelligence Oversight Board.
what_it_does: This order changed the number of members on the Intelligence Oversight Board. Based on the title, it raised the number of people who can serve. The board advises the President on whether US intelligence activities follow the law. No summary was provided, so the exact new number and other details are not stated here.

who_it_affects.group: Members and appointees of the Intelligence Oversight Board
who_it_affects.how: More people could be appointed to serve on the board.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 14, 2003; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
